title: pi-provider-proxy configuration
description: Per-provider proxy routing for pi. Route each provider direct, through a proxy, or inherit pi's own httpProxy settings.

enabled.description: Master switch. false makes every request inherit pi's settings (extension installed but inert).

default.description: Rule for hosts that match no provider and no host rule. Defaults to "inherit".

providers.description: Per-provider rules, keyed by pi provider id (e.g. "provider-a", "provider-b").

hosts.description: Escape hatch: rules for raw hosts, supporting "api.example.com", "*.example.com" and "*".

loopbackAlwaysDirect.description: Always connect directly to loopback, link-local, RFC1918 and .local hosts, regardless of rules.

statusLine.description: Footer status line: auto shows it only when explicit provider rules exist.

statusLineShowDirect.description: Also list direct/inherit rules in the footer status line. Off by default: only providers routed through a proxy are advertised.

proxy.description: Proxy URL (http:// or https://). Required for mode=proxy unless default.proxy is set.
